def min_external_distance(r, c, grid):
    # Check each direction

    for sr in range(r-1, -1, -1):

        sr += 1  # Continue scanning

    # Down

    # West

    # East

        if grid[r][sc] == 2 or grid[r+1][sc] == 2:  # Has a 2 in this track row

    return min_dist
